epics.title: Repository & CI/CD Foundation
epics.description: Set up repository structure, branching strategy, CI/CD pipelines, and automated workflows for each microservice. This is a blocking foundation epic — all other work depends on working automation.

stories.title: Repository Workflow & Automation Setup: [service-name]
stories.description: Configure repository structure, branch protection, CI/CD pipeline, automated testing, linting, and deployment workflow for [service-name]. This story is a prerequisite for all feature work in this service.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository created with standard structure
Branch protection rules enforced (no direct push to main/dev)
CI pipeline runs on every PR: lint, typecheck, unit tests, build
CD pipeline deploys to staging on merge to dev
CD pipeline deploys to production on merge to main (with approval gate)
Code coverage threshold enforced (>= 80%)
Security scanning (dependency audit, SAST) runs on every PR
Docker build and push automated
Infrastructure as Code for service deployment included
README with local development setup instructions
risks: Cloud provider permissions may need escalation
Docker registry setup may have organizational approval process

subtasks.title: Initialize repository with standard structure
subtasks.description: Create repository with folder structure, .gitignore, README stub, package.json/pyproject.toml, tsconfig, and editor config.
subtasks.scope: Root-level config files, src/ directory structure
acceptanceCriteria: Folder structure matches architecture conventions
All config files present and valid
README documents local setup

testPlans.description: Clone repo, run install, verify no errors

subtasks.notes: Use organizational template if one exists

subtasks.title: Configure branch protection and branching strategy
subtasks.description: Set up branch protection rules for main and dev branches. Configure required reviewers, status checks, and merge strategy (squash + rebase).
subtasks.inputs: Repository from T001, git workflow conventions
acceptanceCriteria: Direct push to main blocked
Direct push to dev blocked
PR requires at least 1 approval
PR requires CI passing before merge
Squash merge enforced

testPlans.description: Attempt direct push to protected branch, verify rejection

subtasks.notes: May require admin access to repository settings

subtasks.title: Create CI pipeline (lint, typecheck, test, build)
subtasks.description: Configure CI pipeline that runs on every PR. Steps: install deps, lint, typecheck, run unit tests with coverage, build.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline triggers on PR to dev and main
Lint step fails pipeline on violations
Typecheck step fails pipeline on errors
Test step fails pipeline if coverage below threshold
Build step produces deployable artifact
Pipeline completes in under 5 minutes for empty project

testPlans.description: Open PR with lint error, verify pipeline fails
Open clean PR, verify pipeline passes

subtasks.notes: Cache dependencies between runs for speed

subtasks.title: Create CD pipeline (staging deploy on merge to dev)
subtasks.description: Configure continuous deployment to staging environment when PRs merge to dev branch. Include health check verification after deploy.
subtasks.inputs: CI pipeline, cloud infrastructure, container registry
subtasks.outputs: Automated staging deployment on merge to dev
subtasks.scope: CI/CD config, deployment manifests, health check endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: Merge to dev triggers automatic deploy to staging
Deploy builds and pushes container image
Deploy updates staging environment with new image
Health check runs after deploy and fails pipeline if unhealthy
Rollback to previous version on health check failure
Deploy notification sent to team channel

testPlans.description: Merge to dev, verify staging updated

subtasks.notes: Production deploy (merge to main) should require manual approval gate

subtasks.title: Add security scanning to CI pipeline
subtasks.description: Add dependency vulnerability scanning and static analysis security testing (SAST) to the CI pipeline. Fail on high/critical vulnerabilities.
subtasks.scope: CI config, security tool config files
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency audit runs on every PR
Pipeline fails on high or critical vulnerabilities
SAST scan runs on source code
Results visible in PR comments or CI output
Suppressions require justification comment

testPlans.description: Add known-vulnerable dependency, verify pipeline fails
expectedOutputs: pipeline fails at security scan step

subtasks.notes: Use tools appropriate to stack: npm audit, trivy, semgrep, etc.

subtasks.title: Create Dockerfile and container build config
subtasks.description: Create multi-stage Dockerfile following security best practices (non-root user, minimal base image, pinned versions). Configure container registry push in CI.
subtasks.inputs: Application code structure, base image selection
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-stage build (deps → build → runtime)
Non-root user in final stage
Minimal base image (slim/alpine/distroless)
No secrets in image layers
Image builds in under 3 minutes (cold cache)
Image size under 200MB for Node, under 100MB for Go

testPlans.description: Build image, run container, verify health endpoint

subtasks.title: Create IaC for service deployment
subtasks.description: Write infrastructure-as-code for deploying this service to the target environment. Include compute, networking, secrets, and observability configuration.
subtasks.inputs: Cloud architecture docs, network topology, selected IaC tool
acceptanceCriteria: Service deployable with single command/pipeline
Secrets injected from secret manager (never hardcoded)
Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) configured
Resource limits and autoscaling defined
Network security groups restrict access appropriately
terraform plan shows expected resources with no errors

testPlans.description: Run plan/preview, verify no errors and expected resources

subtasks.notes: Do NOT apply to production without approval. Plan only for verification.
